data.name: Boy
data.gender_notes: Boy is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'paida,' meaning 'offspring' or 'child.' In a Christian context, the name Boy represents the divine masculine energy and the innocence and purity of childhood. The name Boy carries the meaning “Young male” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Boy usually hope their child will grow to embody young male and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Boy belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young male.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Boy total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
data.cultural_impact: The name Boy has timeless roots and has been in use since ancient times. It was common in the Anglo-Saxon culture and is still popular across cultures today. Its essence lies in the fundamental fact that every child is aBoy, regardless of status or background.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Boy signifies the divine child or the pure, innocent soul. This name is a reminder of the significance of childhood and the lessons we can learn from being a child, such as faith, trust, and dependence on God. It also signifies the potential for growth and development into the divine masculine energy we see in God the Father.
